# Aunt Jamesina

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunty  <sub>[v3 c35 P2](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0002)</sub>; Aunt Jimsie  <sub>[v3 c19 P41](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0041)</sub>

## Appearance

Aunt Jamesina is a tiny old woman with snow-white hair worn in quaint little puffs over her ears. She has a softly-triangular, pink-cheaked face that retains a girlish look, along with large, soft blue eyes filled with youth and hope.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

## Personality

Aunt Jamesina possesses a youthful, cheerful disposition, an unquenchable vitality, and a lively sense of humor. Old-fashioned in her style and opinions, she is relaxed and easygoing rather than strictly supervisory toward the young women in her care. She is candid, pragmatic, and forgiving, holding a warm affection for her companions despite their unconventional ways.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c19 P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037), [v3 c19 P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040), [v3 c35 P15](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0015), [v3 c35 P17](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0017), [v3 c35 P21](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0021)_

## Traits

- Old-fashioned  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>
- Good-humored  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c35 P20](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0020)</sub>
- Easygoing  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>
- Forgiving  <sub>[v3 c35 P15](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0015), [v3 c35 P17](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0017)</sub>

## Abilities

- Knitting  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- Live comfortably and take life easy  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

## History

Aunt Jamesina lived through a colorful youth with numerous suitors and eventually married, though she later became a widow. She took in the Sarah-cat from her washerwoman and adopted Joseph when a friend moved to Vancouver. She moved into Patty's Place to act as housemother for Anne Shirley, Priscilla Grant, Philippa Gordon, and Stella Maynard during their studies at Redmond College. She managed the household with grace and humor, accommodating all three resident cats, including Rusty. Upon the girls' graduation and the return of the property's owners, she took all three cats home with her.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c16 P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 c16 P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 c16 P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c35 P23](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0023), [v3 c35 P25](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0025), [v3 c38 P8](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0008)_

## Background by volume

- Had a husband who named her pet cat  <sub>[v3 c16 P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>
- Had several beaux in her youth, including Jim Elwood, Dan Winston, Milton Edwards, and Horatio Reeve  <sub>[v3 c35 P25](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0025)</sub>
- Was courted by three old widowers back home  <sub>[v3 c35 P23](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0023)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m old enough to indulge myself in the matter of shoes and opinions.  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

> So, as far as I am concerned, you can all go to destruction in your own way.  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

> There are three old widowers at home who have been casting sheep’s eyes at me for some time. You children needn’t think you own all the romance in the world.  <sub>[v3 c35 P23](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0023)</sub>

> It isn’t in good taste to make fun of your beaux; but, I always did it myself.  <sub>[v3 c35 P21](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0021)</sub>

> Holding spite doesn’t seem worth while when you get along in years.  <sub>[v3 c35 P17](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0017)</sub>
